conclusion.interpretation: Sorting removal achieves large setup reductions and passes the total-time discovery screen on these 24 revealed settings. Hubs still constructs 54,200 cells then declines both batches; setup remains above both predeclared limits. Full S gate fails and C2 remains untouched. No broad confirmation or promotion follows.
limitations: Private two-FE OLS discovery on revealed inputs. No untouched confirmation, public Auto promotion or Mac performance claim.

Raw column artifacts were validated and rehashed on SCC; independent review verified hash consistency and oracle/comparison code but did not recompute numerical oracle errors without those columns. Retained attestations are not a replacement numerical dataset.

Easy/four-worker complete native times remain variable: S 5.63-17.45 ms and Auto 7.12-17.02 ms. The panel does not establish a cause. Paired summaries must not be replaced by ratios of marginal medians.
S changes dynamic-weight projection iteration counts from M 60 to S 59 at both worker counts. Aggregate improvements cannot all be attributed to faster construction.
conclusion.next_direction: A separately planned general admission/refusal rule should avoid material construction when no planned batch can repay it, while preserving the successful S path. Do not route by benchmark name or reopen these gates.
